Note 10. Debt

As of December 31, 2022, the Company was not in compliance with the minimum liquidity covenant under the Senior Credit Facility, and an event of default has occurred and is continuing under the Senior Credit Facility. The Company obtained waivers from the holders of its Convertible Notes with respect to the cross-default provisions of the Convertible Notes. Due to the event of default, the outstanding borrowings under the Senior Credit Facility have been classified as current liabilities as of December 31, 2022.
